candidate.answerReason: Setting both variables equal to 1 sums the signed numerical coefficients and gives (1-2+1)^7=0.

methods.label: Set both variables equal to one
methods.explanation:
Setting \(x=y=1\) turns each expanded term \(c x^i y^j\) into its numerical coefficient \(c\), including its sign. Thus this substitution adds all the coefficients without requiring the expansion.

The required sum is
\[
(1^2-2\cdot1\cdot1+1^2)^7
=(1-2+1)^7=0.
\]
Therefore the sum is \(0\), choice A.
